### Hezekiah's Foolish Decision
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/hezekiahs-foolish-decision
Passage: 2 Kings 20:16-17
Points:
- Even godly leaders are fallen and unable to maintain flawless obedience to God's covenant.
- Hezekiah displayed his royal storehouses to the Babylonian envoys to imply a potential military alliance.
- Courting foreign alliances violated biblical commands and revealed a failure to trust solely in the Lord.
- Isaiah warned that the very empire Hezekiah sought to impress would eventually plunder Judah and exile his descendants.
- Hezekiah's indifferent reaction cautions believers against relying on worldly alliances and personal comfort.

### Devotional: 2 Kings 20
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/2-kings-20-hebrews-2-hosea-13-psalms-137-138/
Passage: 2 Kings 20:12-19
Points:
- Despite a faithful past, Hezekiah succumbed to pride and selfishness in his later years.
- When Babylonian emissaries visited, he acted as a proud potentate and flaunted his wealth instead of walking humbly.
- When Isaiah confronted him with the prophecy of future Babylonian exile, Hezekiah offered no repentance or intercession.
- He felt relieved solely because disaster would not strike during his own lifetime, demonstrating callous self-absorption.
- Believers are warned not to end life complacent and self-centered, destroying the legacy of their earlier godly achievements.
